changes.title: Amazon MWAA now supports DuckDB operators
changes.detail: Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (Amazon MWAA) now supports DuckDB operators. DuckDB is an embedded analytical database that lets customers perform data quality checks, summaries, and transformations on data from sources DuckDB supports, including Amazon S3. Native support is available for DuckDB on Amazon MWAA Provisioned environments running Apache Airflow 3.3.1. DuckDB comes preinstalled and preconfigured for AWS connections in the latest MWAA Airflow 3.3.1 update.
